referencePaired.scope: Postprocessing matched existing Lucene reports; no reindexing or test-dependent policy selection.
referencePaired.qualification: Lucene is a whole-pipeline reference: field statistics, norms, stopwords, graphs, title boosts and repeated terms differ.

sensitivity.status: Separate metadata-only unseen-TEST sensitivity; original experiment retained unchanged
sensitivity.calibration: Retain each original full-DEV fitted threshold; DEV exposure is development, not an unseen-DEV claim. No threshold refit or selection on TEST.
qualifications: The original full4250 and separate unseen4244 results must be shown together.
Exposure is determined by same-language IDs or global normalized query text, never outcomes.
This excludes detectable text/identity overlap, not unknown semantic paraphrases.
Paired1000-query bootstrap intervals are conditional on this fixed sampled corpus/cohort and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
No-known-positive background may contain unjudged relevant passages; apparent false acceptance is not universal irrelevance.

policy.status: Post-diagnostic exploratory Korean compound hypothesis, frozen before any challenger retrieval scores. Separate from the independent primary17 study; do not merge it into the original nine-method macro.
policy.hypothesis: KoDic Compound metadata can expose useful constituent words omitted by the frozen flat stem analysis, while an unchanged exact lane preserves whole-word precision evidence.

data.queries: All identical frozen Korean selected development/test queries and 0/1 judgments. No resampling, exclusions or tuning on these scores. Known Korean language is an oracle hint.

policy.compoundRule: STEM only: expand KoDic Compound entries only when component surfaces concatenate exactly to the original token surface and safe original offsets exist. Emit one flat component sequence; no recursive expansion or arbitrary substring splitting. EXACT remains the frozen precise whole-word analysis. Distinct version/fingerprint and binary/source hashes required.

ranking.engine: Same SQLite FTS5 encoded-token proxy and content/title BM25 weights1/2 as primary
ranking.order: Score descending then identical deterministic document hash rowid
ranking.or: Unique analyzed stem tokens are OR clauses; explicitly quoted full input remains a phrase
ranking.and: Require every unique analyzed stem token; quoted full input remains a phrase
ranking.msm60: Require ceil(0.6 * unique analyzed stem terms), counted inside the matching cursor before top-k; quoted phrases unchanged
ranking.rrf: Fuse exact OR and stem OR ranks, k60, input depth1000/lane, output100; never add raw BM25 scores
ranking.exactTier: Bounded union of exact phrase, exact AND, stem OR candidates; phrase then all-original-terms then remaining stems, with stem rank/document hash ties

policy.checks: Assert all document/query exact-lane token sequences match between variants before ranking; require distinct stem semantic fingerprints. Fresh synthetic retrieval controls cover issue902 vocabulary, whole 승차권 versus unrelated 승차 and 권 contexts, quoted/nonadjacent phrase negatives, and intact exact-lane whole words. Controls are not additional held-out human judgments.

analysis.comparisons: Each challenger method versus its corresponding original-native method, query paired; no cherry-picked language/query cohorts
analysis.uncertainty: 1000 paired query bootstrap replicates, fixed base-policy seed plus compound/size/method; 95% unadjusted intervals conditional on this sampled Korean corpus
analysis.calibration: Shared development-only per-method/per-size balanced-accuracy threshold; report separate no-known-positive acceptance, explicit-negative/unjudged top1 and score distributions
analysis.interpretation: Korean-only post-diagnostic exploratory evidence, not independent confirmation of a globally selected default. Preserve whole-word exact evidence; report gains and regressions together.

policy.privacy: Only public query IDs, metrics, hashes, counts and timing metadata in reports. Public corpus/query strings and analysis caches stay outside Git. No changes to original primary drivers, engine defaults or live stores.

qualifications: Post-diagnostic exploratory Korean-only comparison, not a primary17 macro.
Exact means unchanged segmented NFKC/lowercase surfaces, not guaranteed literal orthographic whole words in every context.
OR retrieves1000 for fusion reuse; output metrics use100. Timing is not an isolated production latency comparison.

policy.status: Exploratory post-aggregate causal follow-up selected because French/Persian regressions were observed. Protocol fixed before any profile retrieval scores; not independent confirmation or a new primary17 macro.

data.queries: Identical frozen selected development/test queries and all0/1judgments; no resampling, filters or parameter tuning. Known split language remains an oracle.

policy.scope: STEM only and only configured French Latin spans or configured Persian Arabic spans. Use original core normalized SURFACE, never an already stemmed term. Exact tokens and all other script/language spans remain the frozen core.
policy.boundaryOnly: Apply compatible Charabia finer token boundaries, then NFKC and locale casing before the same Frostem algorithm. No Charabia lossy normalization. Unsafe offset mapping falls back to the entire original token.
policy.languageNormalization: Same finer boundaries, plus explicit compatible Charabia language normalization BEFORE Frostem. Scoped lossy normalization is recorded; no global mark stripping. Unsafe offset mapping falls back to the entire original token.
policy.ranking: Same encoded-token SQLiteFTS5 content/title weights1/2 and document-hash tie order. OR unique stem terms; AND all; MSMceil60percent. Whole-input quotes remain phrases. FixedRRF k60 input1000 output100, and original deterministic exact-phrase/all-original-terms/stem tiers. Never add raw scores.
policy.preflight: Require all original/profile exact-lane document/query token streams equal before ranking, and distinct stable stem semantic fingerprints. Original baseline must reproduce original primary French/Persian profiles and per-query results when interpreted.
policy.analysis: Per-language and equal-weight two-language macro nDCG10/Recall100/MRR10, each profile paired versus corresponding original method;1000 query-bootstrap replicates,95percent unadjusted conditional intervals. Same fullDEV-only balanced-accuracy calibration; separate no-known-positive acceptance/status/score distributions. Original and every gain/regression shown; no winning policy selected on these scores.
policy.controls: ActualCLItoken/FTS controls record French elision/curly apostrophe/ligature/accent contrasts and Persian halfspace/marks/digit contrasts with inventedtext, including broader-match negatives. In particular, do not claim semantic negation detection: Persian negative and positive forms may share an OR token. Exact-mode and original offsets are checked independently.
policy.privacy: Public corpus/query text and caches stay outsideGit. Reports contain only publicIDs, metrics, hashes, configuration and counts. Fresh synthetic control traces are explicitly labelled invented data. No frozen core, primary driver, corpus or production default changes.

diagnostics.scope: Independent interpretation of frozen authored diagnostics plus transparent annotation overlay and exploratory fair-lane control. No engine, fixture, query or ranking-policy changes.
limitations: Synthetic parallel templates; no native-speaker review; approximately189–194 body characters per document. Not a natural-population accuracy estimate.
Fair-lane policy was declared after observing original results: exploratory post-audit control, not independent confirmatory holdout evidence.

Fair control preserves the pre-truncation candidate universe for supported OR/phrase queries; document lengths, per-lane truncation, rank fusion and BM25 statistics still differ. It does not isolate document frequency alone.
Original baseline uses Porter/unicode61 and matching raw query-word compilation on the same five-field synthetic schema, not the deployed content/title pipeline.
Annotation overlay changes only compatible alternatives for two queries; generic Spanish revisar remains ambiguous.
Low precision@10 reflects a fixed10-slot denominator even when an exact identifier has only one or two valid records. Do not read it as precision among returned records.
Native encrypted lifecycle/platform evidence is separate from authored language quality; initial populated legacy-to-native production migration is not yet a bounded rollout proof.
recommendation: Retain a global candidate index with per-document/span analysis metadata; do not turn a language guess into a document visibility filter.
Preserve a separate spelling-aware/literal representation for identifiers and explicit quotes; richer morphology alone is insufficient.
Use bounded query-analysis alternatives when short-query language is uncertain, while treating exhaustive script-language fanout as a research arm with precision and work costs.

Do not add per-language physical shards plus equal rank fusion based on this evidence: the fair control restores reachability but adds no consistent quality benefit over global scoring with surface priority.
Keep same-script mixed paragraphs, context-dependent Korean tokenization and irregular morphology as explicit unresolved quality cases.

limitations: Oracle-language public pools, not automatic routing or full MIRACL.
Diagnostic cases are short authored controls without native-speaker review.
Profile/compound follow-ups are exploratory and not spliced into the primary17 macro.
Fresh-cache parity does not remove the existing approximate incremental-statistics behavior.
Score-based no-answer acceptance is weak; rank scores are not probabilities.
Native baseline is integrated; newer language-profile CLI challengers, first populated-store migration, full packaging and production routing remain work.
